purpose: Prevent a meaningless A/B/C/D work comparison unless each dream arm has an actual arm-specific artifact available to the worker and the no-dream control does not.
gate_requirements: A/B/C must expose immutable arm-specific dream artifact content or a verifiable content reference, not only an output hash
the work runner must prove which arm-specific artifact was actually supplied to each blinded worker
D must receive no dream artifact
all four workers must receive identical task fixtures, scorer rules, tools and network policy
arm identity must remain hidden from scorer until scores are locked
dream artifacts remain DREAM/SYNTHETIC and may not write Stable
missing artifact content, provenance mismatch, fixture drift, scorer drift, network drift or Stable write fails closed
reason: Run-001 computed evidence proves deterministic arm output hashes but does not itself provide work-consumable transformed content. Running the work fixture now could not establish a causal effect of dreaming because the worker would have no evidenced arm-specific dream material to use.
next_required_engineering: Persist isolated A/B/C transformed artifact content (or immutable references to it) with hashes and parent provenance, then wire those artifacts into blinded work runners while keeping D artifact-free.
claim_boundary: This gate is evidence of an experimental-design blocker, not evidence for or against dream benefit.
